measurementNote: Coordinates are zero-based source-image pixels. Bounds are measured approximations from a raster reference, not vector construction data. Derivations declare any source-pixel transformation and its exact output mapping.
artifactPolicy: One evidence artifact per reusable visual element. No workflow-state, application-logic, or duplicate composition screenshots are included. Pure crops are lossless; the primary treatment joins two declared lossless source segments after removing the flag columns. Recreate components from DESOGN.md tokens; do not stretch these images into production UI.

artifacts.purpose: Cloudy translucent title bar with enough source context to reveal its glass boundary.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Inspect material and edge treatment; implement the header at 52–53px visual height and never stretch the raster.
artifacts.notes: Uses the cloudiest left-window header with neutral canvas above/beside it and a narrow body transition below.

artifacts.purpose: Thin cyan-blue refraction wave separating header material from body material.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Recreate as a subtle 1px core plus 4–8px glow; do not tile the crop.
artifacts.notes: Brightness fades toward the edges and the path varies vertically by only a few pixels.

artifacts.purpose: Pale-blue menu surface, control rhythm, selection material, and lower panel radius.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Use as a visual-system sample for pane density and material, not as application data or a screen composition.
artifacts.notes: A single representative menu crop is retained because the pane material is shared across the source composition.

artifacts.purpose: Content-free sample of the near-white operational glass, side outlines, and lower panel radii.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Use for surface, border, and corner treatment only; layout and application content are specified in prose.
artifacts.notes: The lower blank portion of the left operational pane avoids headings, empty-state copy, metadata, progress, and buttons.

artifacts.purpose: Narrow luminous trough between menu and operational panes.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Implement as a 4–8px gap with low-contrast curved edge strokes, not as a dark rule.
artifacts.notes: The apparent divider is formed by adjacent panel edges plus light negative space.

artifacts.purpose: High-contrast blue liquid-glass primary treatment sampled from the selected English menu control, including the cyan rim, blue face, highlights, radius, and shadow.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Use only as a primary or selected-control appearance sample; the English label, checkmark, width, and menu semantics are source context, not a component contract.
artifacts.notes: The 31 source columns containing the flag are removed and the two remaining source-exact segments are joined. No pixels are synthesized, blurred, interpolated, scaled, or lossily encoded.

artifacts.purpose: Outlined blue secondary-button material and radius.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Use as a secondary-button appearance sample; button meaning and label come from the consuming screen.
artifacts.notes: Thin blue stroke over a translucent near-white glass face.

artifacts.purpose: Shared full-width bottom shell termination with both panes, center trough, lower frame, radii, and shadow.
artifacts.reuseGuidance: Use for lower shell geometry only; it contains no footer controls and has no workflow-state meaning.
artifacts.notes: Uses the content-free left window and includes neutral canvas below so the outer shadow is visible.
